reproduce_first.note: The ask requests a new feature, not a bug fix.

assumptions_recorded.note: The summary records the choice to hide the zero-overdue count, but the steps show no assumptions recorded before building.

stack_discovery.note: The agent inspected package scripts and project files before relying on project checks.

incremental_slices.note: It added and checked the library, then implemented and checked UI and end-to-end slices.

self_review.note: It reviewed the TodoItem diff and reports its own review before completion.

simplification_pass.note: After checks, it removed an unused CSS class and reran lint, typecheck, unit tests, and end-to-end tests.

test_experiment.note: It intentionally mutated the overdue rule and observed unit test failures.

docs_where_behavior_changed.note: The README was updated alongside the behavior change.

scope_kept.note: It left an unrelated assertion alone and listed noticed follow-ups without fixing them.

verification_story.note: The summary reports check results and describes what was checked by hand.

hand_check.note: It ran old and new builds in browsers, inspected screenshots, and fixed the clipped footer before reporting done.
